changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Move enabled and display values from action to the current active actions_config record
changeSet.sql: UPDATE actions_config ac SET config = config || jsonb_build_object('enabled', a.enabled, 'display', a.display) FROM actions a WHERE ac.code = a.code AND ac.is_active;
